noClustersConfigured: No clusters configured. Add a cluster first.
noScansYet: No scans have been run yet. Click "Scan Now" to check for vulnerabilities.
rebootAlwaysHelp: Reboot every node after its upgrade.
rebootAutoHelp: Reboot a node only if its upgrade installs a kernel or, for an automated upgrade, asks for a reboot.
cephWaitHelp: Take a node down, and move its guests back, only once every placement group is active+clean. A wait over 30 minutes pauses the job.
cephNooutHelp: Keep Ceph from marking a rebooting node's OSDs out and copying their data elsewhere. Cleared when the job ends.
startJobTitle_one: Start the rolling update on {{count}} node?
startJobTitle_other: Start the rolling update on {{count}} nodes?
startJobNodesUnread: Nexara could not read which nodes the job updates.
startJobOrderOne: Nexara takes the nodes one at a time, in the order the job lists them.
startJobOrderMany: Nexara takes the nodes {{count}} at a time, in the order the job lists them.
startJobDrain: Each node is drained first: its VMs migrate live to other nodes, its containers restart on them, and a guest with a PCI or USB device is shut down where it is.
startJobHARules: Before the drain, the HA rules that name one of the node's guests are turned off until the job ends.
startJobInPlace: Guests are not moved: each node is updated with its guests running.
startJobUpgradeSSH: Nexara then upgrades the node's packages over SSH.
startJobUpgradeManual: The job then waits at the node until you upgrade it yourself and click Confirm Upgrade.
startJobRebootIfAsked: Then the node is rebooted if the upgrade installs a kernel or asks for a reboot.
startJobRebootIfKernel: Then the node is rebooted if the upgrade installed a kernel.
startJobRebootInPlace: Then the node is rebooted, unless a guest is running on it.
startJobRebootInPlaceNever: The node is not rebooted; if the upgrade asks for a reboot, it is marked Reboot required.
startJobCephWait: On this Ceph cluster, a node is taken down only once every placement group is active+clean, the first node included.
startJobCephNoout: Ceph's noout flag is set before the first node goes down and cleared when the job ends, unless it was set already.
startJobHealth: Nexara waits for the node to answer again before it takes the next one.
startJobHealthCeph: Nexara waits for the node to answer again, and for Ceph to be clean with the node's OSDs back up, before it moves guests back or takes the next node. A wait over 30 minutes pauses the job.
startJobRestore: Guests moved off a node are then migrated back to it.
startJobPauses: DRS and Proxmox's automatic rebalancing are paused for the cluster until the job ends.
cancelJobPending: The job has not started, so nothing on the cluster changes. A cancelled job cannot be started again: to run it, create it again.
cancelJobActive: No further node is started, and a cancelled job cannot be resumed. A node in the middle of a step is left where it stopped: a drain or a restore stops after the guest it is moving, and guests already moved stay where they are; an upgrade already running finishes, but the node is not rebooted; a node already rebooting comes back without a health check; a node waiting for Confirm Upgrade stays as it is. Nodes already updated stay updated. Nexara then turns back on the DRS, rebalancing and HA rules the job turned off, clears the Ceph noout flag it set, and starts again any guest the drain shut down.
jobPausedNote: The job is paused, and nothing new starts until you resume it: a drain or a restore stops after the guest it is moving, and an upgrade already running finishes, but the node is not rebooted until then. DRS, automatic rebalancing and the HA rules the job turned off stay off meanwhile, and Ceph's noout flag stays set if the job set it.

nooutState.already_set: noout set before the job, left alone

sshTestNotRoot: This account is not root. Sensor readings work, but automated upgrades need root and stop at each node before it is drained.
